FEATURE_TREE.INVARIANT: Clan forms and paternal spelling findings use birth surnames, excluding explicit married surnames and ambiguous names shared with a husband; source names remain literal.

A saved clan surname decision normalizes every matched person's display, retains literal source names, and derives a missing father's surname from identified children without assigning a mother's maiden name.
FEATURE_TREE.INTENT: Combine canonical attributed snapshots, additive evidence, identity decisions and effective life assessments without family-specific engine code.
FEATURE_TREE.INVARIANT: Accepted cross-intake identity unifies cards without promoting imported hypotheses, and removing the decision restores the source graph.
Rejected packages name their file, claim and cause in family checks and block every working or reader graph, including desk and reader delivery.
Final ancestry is acyclic and the root resolves after identity decisions.
Consumers can enrich pre-identity cards before applying decisions once.
Public presentation enrichment runs before one identity pass and cannot bypass the declared privacy projection.
Sources may be registered without a reader update.
Sources resolve across contributions regardless of file order or mutual source dependencies; only applied packages commit graph data.
An intake source has one declaration owner; duplicate diagnostics identify the contribution and configured evidence file and explain reference-only evidence.
A recorded event bounds its participant and their parent once, over a verified/export link or a relationship weighted at least 0.30. Dates of estimates and identity proposals provide no bound.
A documentary decision updates only its named relationship, retains superseded facts and places newly read events ahead of imported estimates in reader delivery without rewriting the snapshot.

MODULE_TREE_BUILDER.INVARIANT: Snapshot and contribution note strings normalize to text objects before checks and publication.
The working reference index resolves active people and immutable merged ids.

MODULE_TREE_LIFE.INVARIANT: The shorter family age horizon uses recorded life evidence.
A merge preserves explicit declarations and refusals on either participant. Missing evidence follows the ordinary age horizons. Contradictory dated deaths remain visible conflicts.
Privacy life declarations on merged ids follow their active successors.
The family age horizon permits documents without changing public disclosure or overriding explicit living decisions.
An explicit unknown decision retains protection in family display.
Only an everywhere death decision grants the same disclosure to the public and the family.
Recorded events set life status before proposals and presentation dates are applied. Import precautions carry no family declaration.
A paper dates its own participants. Citations and family links alone cannot lend its date to another card.

MODULE_TREE_CONTRIBUTIONS.INVARIANT: Contributed spouse unions retain weight, basis and sources atomically with existing or newly added people.
An existing unnamed person can receive sourced name parts through people, retaining the earlier name in working nameHistory.
Reader update order uses recorded dates and source ids so a clean archive preserves inspected bytes across filesystems.

MODULE_TREE_IDENTITIES.INVARIANT: An accepted merge below 0.9 weighs only on the links a line crosses between the two cards.
A source-backed withdrawal removes a marked import card and its import links from the active tree while preserving the frozen snapshot.

MODULE_TREE_AMENDMENTS.INVARIANT: A personally attributed answer settles the issued revision and person. A relative cannot override a refusal.
